note: 7: the ou-ligature of ἀλȣ́μενος is worn and images as a upsilon — training on it would teach the model to read real upsilons as the ligature. STILL RULED DAMAGED.

reversed.why: ἐπίγειον was ruled damaged on 2026-08-06 against the 300 dpi 1955 reprint, where there is γ, a fragment of ε, blank paper, then ο. At 400 dpi the ε is still broken — weak middle bar, printed as a dot — but a clear short vertical follows it. John, on the 10× crop: "Look like epsilon iota." The ε breaks in BOTH copies, which is the type; the ι is whole in one and absent in the other, which is reproduction loss, not a failed impression. Held until this rebuild so the ruling would not disagree with the data the running model was trained on.
reversed.rule: Record the printer's errors as printed means the PRINTER'S, not the photocopier's. Re-check every damage site when the scan changes.
